rawConfiguration.text:
## Query Performance (Top Queries)
Aggregated view from db.server.top_query — disabled by default upstream; enabled in this test lab's receiver config.

widgets.title: Top queries by total wait time

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Log SELECT latest(`db.query.text`) AS 'Query', filter(sum(`mysql.events_statements_summary_by_digest.count_star`), WHERE `mysql.events_statements_summary_by_digest.count_star` >= 0) AS 'Executions (delta)', filter(sum(`mysql.events_statements_summary_by_digest.sum_timer_wait`), WHERE `mysql.events_statements_summary_by_digest.sum_timer_wait` >= 0) AS 'Total wait (s, delta)' WHERE `event.name` = 'db.server.top_query' AND `db.system.name` = 'mysql' AND `mysql.instance.endpoint` = {{endpoint}} FACET `mysql.events_statements_summary_by_digest.digest` AS 'Digest' LIMIT 25

widgets.title: Top 10 queries by total wait time

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Log SELECT sum(`mysql.events_statements_summary_by_digest.sum_timer_wait`) WHERE `event.name` = 'db.server.top_query' AND `db.system.name` = 'mysql' AND `mysql.instance.endpoint` = {{endpoint}} FACET `mysql.events_statements_summary_by_digest.digest` LIMIT 10

rawConfiguration.text: ### Query Efficiency — Rows Examined vs. Sent

widgets.title: Rows examined vs. sent by query

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Log SELECT sum(`mysql.events_statements_summary_by_digest.sum_rows_examined`) AS 'Rows examined', sum(`mysql.events_statements_summary_by_digest.sum_rows_sent`) AS 'Rows sent', latest(`db.query.text`) AS 'Query' WHERE `event.name` = 'db.server.top_query' AND `db.system.name` = 'mysql' AND `mysql.instance.endpoint` = {{endpoint}} FACET `mysql.events_statements_summary_by_digest.digest` AS 'Digest' LIMIT 25

widgets.title: Worst selectivity (rows examined per row sent)

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Log SELECT sum(`mysql.events_statements_summary_by_digest.sum_rows_examined`)/sum(`mysql.events_statements_summary_by_digest.sum_rows_sent`) AS 'Rows examined per row sent' WHERE `event.name` = 'db.server.top_query' AND `db.system.name` = 'mysql' AND `mysql.instance.endpoint` = {{endpoint}} AND `mysql.events_statements_summary_by_digest.sum_rows_sent` > 0 FACET `mysql.events_statements_summary_by_digest.digest` LIMIT 10

rawConfiguration.text:
### Digest Metrics Correlation
mysql.statement_event.* metrics are disabled by default upstream; enabled in this test lab.

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT latest(`mysql.statement_event.count`) WHERE `metricName` = 'mysql.statement_event.count' AND `mysql.instance.endpoint` = {{endpoint}} FACET digest_text AS 'Query text', event_state LIMIT 25

widgets.title: Statement event wait time by digest (metric)

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT latest(`mysql.statement_event.wait.time`) WHERE `metricName` = 'mysql.statement_event.wait.time' AND `mysql.instance.endpoint` = {{endpoint}} FACET digest_text TIMESERIES LIMIT 10
